creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 4: links the daemon holds, so a client sees every machine with Muster's app closed. amterp's aim (decision C): a daemon that runs, starts and links on its own, so Foreman works without Muster open. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md section 6 and its stage-4 acceptance cases.

What: the daemon keeps the list of machines the app last gave it and holds those links itself. Each of these is an acceptance case: who owns each tunnel while an app is open and how it passes to the daemon when the app closes, without contention; what the daemon keeps, and dropping a machine removed from the config; what a successor daemon restores after a handoff; two apps on one daemon; a failed login reaching a client as the machine's status; the human's home declared by the machine the app runs on rather than inferred from who dialed (crates/muster-msg/src/service.rs).

Blocked by the spike that measures ssh from a daemon with no app.
title: MIP-10 stage 4: links the daemon holds, so Muster can be closed
